scope: Offline visual PRD. Existing personal portrait atlas is embedded unchanged in the retained home scene. Remaining UI is low-fidelity. Synthetic in-memory demos; no network, AI calls, persistence, app or service changes.

interactive_demos.behavior: Portrait and contact buttons use the same mentor index, messages and draft. Different mentors remain isolated. Sending appends only user message.

Select 2–4; create a new distinct group even for same members. Clear selection after creation to prevent immediate repeated submission. Cancel selection creates no group. Renaming preserves group identity and draft.
Lists include newly created empty groups. Changing selected group preserves each draft; original and new groups are distinct. Synthetic state exists only until refresh.

privacy.handling: Original local PNG embedded unchanged as data URL; source asset untouched. Never print image base64. Do not publish this artifact without a separate privacy review and authorization.

limitations: Browser rendering not verified; prior local-file browser policy denial respected, no alternate browser or indirect bypass attempted.
No true persistence, restart recovery, network, delivery, AI or accessibility-device validation.
P1–P3 are interaction proposals; group membership changes, old-history visibility and archive/delete details remain for discussion.
Error/archival states are static examples, not working service or destructive actions.

synthetic_dom.method: Minimal synthetic DOM executed in Node VM; not a browser
checks: Portrait and contact row share one private chat and draft
Home group row and group-list row both directly open group chat
Selecting fewer than two disables create; cancel creates no group
Created empty group remains in list; immediate repeated create is prevented
Same members can create distinct groups; draft isolation persists across switches
Rename updates home/list/chat without changing identity or draft; blank name rejected

notes: Two-column flow switches to one column at 800px
Grid tracks use minmax(0,1fr); contacts and text allow wrapping
Controls use minimum 44px target; core screens visible by default
Reduced-motion media rule included; shared portrait source untouched
